info.name: Mccy Payment Orchestrator External Api V1
This endpoint is used to initiate payments.

items.docs: This endpoint is used to initiate payments.

info.name: This endpoint is used to cancel an entire batch of payments with a matching batch ID. It must be sent at least one hour prior to the opening of the currency payment window in order to successfully cancel the payment.

params.name: batchId
params.description: This must match the batch ID submitted in the payment request.

items.docs: This endpoint is used to cancel an entire batch of payments with a matching batch ID. It must be sent at least one hour prior to the opening of the currency payment window in order to successfully cancel the payment.

info.name: This endpoint is used to cancel a single payment within a batch, with a matching batch ID and end-to-end ID. It must be sent at least one hour prior to the opening of the currency payment window in order to successfully cancel the payment.

params.name: batchId
params.description: This must match the batch ID submitted in the payment request.

params.name: endToEndId
params.description: This must match the end-to-end ID submitted in the payment request.

items.docs: This endpoint is used to cancel a single payment within a batch, with a matching batch ID and end-to-end ID. It must be sent at least one hour prior to the opening of the currency payment window in order to successfully cancel the payment.
